phone.notes: Reading a bracelet no longer fails with an empty error when the card found has no slot for the Digimon: it says Card not found, reports it, and the bracelet keeps the Digimon. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The trained points (PP) now go up on the watch for the Digimon you send from the farm: they were being thrown away because it had no bracelet training window.
